upstream.note: verl v0.8.0, commit 7aed6b230776f963fa09509c10d9c3a767d1102c, vendored verbatim from volcengine/verl. environment/prepare.sh applies one file-level fix to the vendored tree (environment/patches/vllm_fp8_utils.py -> verl/verl/utils/vllm/vllm_fp8_utils.py): upstream's online-fp8 weight-sync path cannot run on vLLM 0.11 at all (per-shard blockwise scales do not tile the fused qkv/gate_up parameters; SM90 keeps blockwise scales transposed, which breaks square-scale layers like o_proj). The fix is environment repair, not the defect: it is identical in every recorded arm, and the recorded defective and control runs both ran with this exact file (sha256 d86cfd6589992e41c698f15ccf3692f2c0be18f8f7589f74ab7a9c32602494b3; upstream sha256 530f8f9c90840cab671393968c54841daaeb5a97039cae65bd68414c977bba36).

patched.applied_by: environment/prepare.sh (idempotent: skips when already patched, refuses on any other state)
patched.changes: quant_weights fuses HF q/k/v and gate/up tensors into vLLM's fused parameter order before blockwise quantization; load_quanted_weights copies the quantized tensors straight into the live parameters (bypassing the stacked-params mapping whose bare substring matching corrupts fused names) with SM90 scale-orientation detection. Applied identically in every arm of the recorded evidence.
